author: hasanthehun
text:
🇺🇳 Today, U.S. Rep. for the #HindRajabFoundation, @jake_romm, attended The Hague Group’s Extraordinary Meeting in Defence of International Law at the UN Headquarters in New York. States called for action in response to Israel’s genocide in Palestine and southern Lebanon, but rhetoric is not enough. What is missing: commitments to prosecute and arrest Israeli perpetrators and strengthen universal jurisdiction.

HRF does this work because states will not. We will continue pursuing perpetrators wherever they may be found.
